card.name: Linking words in man-page and fluoroquinolone text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'or', 'and', 'with' or 'value' in two settings: C library man-page return-value sentences, and the fluoroquinolone warning 'have been associated with'.

modes.label: C man-page prose
modes.description: Linking word in a return-value or errno description in C function documentation.
modes.example: RETURN VALUE The tmpfile() function returns a stream descriptor,<< or>> NULL if a unique filename cannot be generated

modes.label: Fluoroquinolone warning
modes.description: The word 'with' after 'have been associated' in the boxed warning about disabling adverse reactions.
modes.example: Fluoroquinolones, including moxifloxacin, have been associated<< with>> disabling and potentially irreversible serious adverse reactions that

card.writes: It suppresses C type words like char and void, so it steers the model away from code type names after these words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in C function documentation and in the fluoroquinolone warning sentence.
